dilemma.metric: Official success fraction times sigmoid L2 penalty; displayed as 100 * score.
dilemma.selection_protocol: Learning rate was selected on the first 20 train images (.001/.0003/.0001). Public test exposed small-step failures and informed a fallback. The first A/B fallback evaluation then motivated reserving retry time. Final A/B scores are development re-tests, not independent confirmation. A/B labels were used as the officially permitted attack targets.
dilemma.final_algorithm: Try Adam lr .0001 with 65% of the local budget, clean and shrink success; on failure retry original lr .001 with the reserved time. Fixed models; no model-weight training. --first-attempt-fraction 1 reproduces the earlier unreserved policy.
dilemma.evaluation_scope: Final reserved-budget code was measured on released A/B only. Public test_public was not rerun after the final changes. Final A/B are development re-tests after observing the earlier A/B results; no hidden leaderboard submission was made.

train20_original.timing_note: Warm attack timing: a clean-accuracy check ran first. Other recorded attack runs use cold process timing.

public_small_step_only_rejected.status: Rejected: smaller step alone regressed on development public split; retained as an honest failed experiment.

released_a_unreserved_fallback.status: Superseded by the reserved-budget development re-test; A gained but B lost one attack and its total score fell.

released_b_unreserved_fallback.status: Superseded by the reserved-budget development re-test; A gained but B lost one attack and its total score fell.
